reason: I resell, so 21,000 in fees on a 30,000 item kills my margin before I even put it on the shelf. The agents I already use are cheaper per kilo when I group orders, and 2 to 3 weeks is not fast enough to beat them on anything.
objection: The fees are almost as much as the item, and I've waited weeks before with agents who promised 2 to 3 weeks, so I don't trust that timeline either.
would_change_my_mind: A lower per-kilo rate for bulk or repeat resellers, something like 8,000 to 9,000 per kilo, with a free first order to prove the delivery time.
